messages:
Emma (CSM): Quick heads up — several onboarding and active tenants are seeing 503s + auth failures calling /v1/embeddings after a token rotation at ~03:12 UTC. Drafting outreach. Who has scope and mitigation numbers? cc @Liam @Devon @Sophia

Liam (Solutions Eng): On it. Preliminary root cause: KMS key rotation created a brief mismatch between token issuer and verifier for dedicated pools in eu-west-1 (race during key sync). Mitigation taken: rolled back the rotation and restarted auth-proxy on impacted hosts at 03:46 UTC. Error rate dropped from ~25% -> ~2%. Full durable fix: add tighter key-sync window + retry/backoff for token validation. ETA for deploy ~4h. Incident bridge: https://bridge.internal/redwood/INC-2025-1872

IncidentBot: Bridge opened by Liam at 03:20 UTC — severity P2. Pager escalated to eng-ml and eng-infra.

Devon (Support Lead): Support tally = 12 impacted account orgs so far (mix of high-touch and self-serve). No data loss. Affected features: embeddings generation and any flows that call embeddings immediately after onboarding SSO. I can share a sanitized list to CS.

Emma (CSM): Thanks — can you paste a short customer-facing blurb I can send? Need separate copy for: 1) High-touch enterprise accounts (personalized, include SLA/credit mention) 2) Broadcast notice for self-serve (in-app banner / status page).

Devon (Support Lead): Drafts below — keep them short. Use :hourglass: and offer proactive credit for enterprise.

Devon (Support Lead): Enterprise (personalized):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about degraded embedding requests affecting a subset of customers in eu-west-1 earlier today (03:10 — 03:50 UTC). We identified an authentication token rotation race that caused intermittent 503s for certain dedicated pools. Our engineers rolled back the rotation and restarted the auth proxy; the issue is mitigated and error rates are back to baseline.

We will follow up with a root cause analysis and a permanent fix timeline. As a gesture of goodwill we will apply a service credit for the affected window and can schedule a 30-min enablement session to review resiliency options for your workloads.

If you saw errors or unusual latency, please reply and I will escalate immediately.

— Emma (Customer Success)
```

Devon (Support Lead): Broadcast (status page / banner):
```
01: We experienced intermittent 503s for embedding requests in eu-west-1 due to an authentication key rotation issue.
02: The rotation was rolled back and the affected hosts were restarted. Error rates are returning to normal.
03: We are deploying a permanent fix with improved key sync and retries.
```

Sophia (GTM Ops): For enterprise outreach, recommend: send personalized note within 30 min, follow with an hour update when we have full scope, include credit offer and optional technical review. I can prepare a template with placeholders for account-specific impact (tokens processed, window, contact).

Raj (Customer Success Manager): OK — plan:
- Emma: send personalized messages to the 4 high-touch accounts now (use Devon's enterprise draft).
- Support: post broadcast to status page and in-app banner (Devon).
- Eng: final ETA & fix details on the bridge, we'll include in the hour update.
- Ops: prepare service credit workflow and log entries for billing (Sophia).

Emma (CSM): Action checklist (I'll own outreach):
- [x] Get sanitized impacted org list from Devon
- [x] Send personalized note to 4 HQ accounts (starting now)
- [ ] Send broadcast/status-page update once copy approved (Sophia + Devon)
- [ ] Follow-up hour update with root cause details and fix ETA (Liam)
